technology_type.evidence: inferred: We integrated global proteome analyses with targeted mass spectrometry (MS), thermal proximity coaggregation-MS (TPCA-MS), and molecular virology assays to determine how ISGs differentially contribute to host antiviral capacities between immune-modulatory cell types.
